boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct University of Redlands academic work environments, including walk-in computing, reservable collaboration rooms, and library-based spaces.

cards.title: Armacost Library
cards.subtitle: Main-campus library study environment
cards.notes: Bring reading or research work and use the library’s documented quiet-study, tutoring, group-work, and music-composition areas.
cards.short_summary: A library setting that supports several study modes in one building.
cards.evidence_claim: The University states that Armacost Library provides open and cozy spaces for quiet study, tutoring, group work, and music composition, plus more than 40 computer workstations.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s current access information before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Fletcher Jones Computing Center General Lab
cards.title: Fletcher Jones General Lab
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Armacost Library
cards.notes: Use this walk-in computer lab when you need a campus PC or Mac; confirm the current term’s lab hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Walk-in computing with both PC and Mac workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: The University says the Fletcher Jones Computing Center General Lab contains PCs and Macs for walk-in use.
cards.source_title: Fletcher Jones Computing Center | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Posted Fall 2026 hours: Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.entity_name: Fletcher Jones Collaborative Learning Space Room 99
cards.title: CLS Room 99
cards.subtitle: Fletcher Jones Computing Center
cards.notes: Plan a group work session around the whiteboard, large monitor, and computer-to-TV connection; arrange a reservation through the listed process.
cards.short_summary: A reservable collaboration room with a whiteboard and display setup.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists CLS Room 99 with a whiteboard, a large monitor, and a computer connected to the TV; departments reserve CLS rooms through the Computing Center or 25Live.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Learning Spaces | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required through the process stated by the University; semester lab usage is arranged through the Registrar’s Office.

cards.entity_name: Fletcher Jones Collaborative Learning Space Room 122
cards.title: CLS Room 122
cards.subtitle: Fletcher Jones Computing Center
cards.notes: Use the large monitor and laptop connection for a shared screen session; contact the Computing Center or use 25Live to reserve it.
cards.short_summary: A reservable room designed for laptop-based shared display work.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists CLS Room 122 with a large-size monitor and laptop connection, and provides a reservation process for Collaborative Learning Spaces.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Learning Spaces | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Departments may reserve a CLS by calling the Computing Center or through 25Live.

cards.entity_name: Fletcher Jones Collaborative Learning Space Room 124
cards.title: CLS Room 124
cards.subtitle: Fletcher Jones Computing Center
cards.notes: Set up a laptop-to-monitor work session for project review or collaborative writing, then reserve through the University’s stated channel.
cards.short_summary: A reservable shared-screen room for small-group academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists CLS Room 124 with a large-size monitor and laptop connection, and identifies it as a Collaborative Learning Space.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Learning Spaces | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Departments may reserve a CLS by calling the Computing Center or through 25Live.

cards.entity_name: Fletcher Jones Collaborative Learning Space Room 126
cards.title: CLS Room 126
cards.subtitle: Fletcher Jones Computing Center
cards.notes: Bring a laptop for a shared-screen meeting or study session, and use the University’s reservation route to secure the room.
cards.short_summary: A reservable monitor-equipped room for collaborative sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists CLS Room 126 with a large-size monitor and laptop connection, and identifies a reservation process for Collaborative Learning Spaces.
cards.source_title: Collaborative Learning Spaces | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Departments may reserve a CLS by calling the Computing Center or through 25Live.

cards.entity_name: Fletcher Jones Computing Center Internet Cafe
cards.title: Fletcher Jones Internet Cafe
cards.subtitle: Fletcher Jones Computing Center
cards.notes: Choose this computing-center area when you need campus computers in an Internet Cafe setting; check the current lab schedule first.
cards.short_summary: An Internet Cafe within the campus computing center.
cards.evidence_claim: The University identifies an Internet Cafe as one of the spaces in the Fletcher Jones Computing Center.
cards.source_title: Fletcher Jones Computing Center | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: The Computing Center publishes term-specific lab hours; verify them before visiting.

cards.title: Fletcher Jones Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Fletcher Jones Computing Center
cards.notes: Use this named computing-center workspace for course-related project work after checking with the center about current availability and procedures.
cards.short_summary: A makerspace listed among the Computing Center’s work environments.
cards.evidence_claim: The University identifies a makerspace among the spaces in the Fletcher Jones Computing Center.
cards.source_title: Fletcher Jones Computing Center | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: Contact the Fletcher Jones Computing Center for current makerspace availability and use details.

cards.title: Interview Room 117
cards.subtitle: Career & Professional Development, 116 Armacost Library
cards.notes: Reserve this room for remote work or an interview using a University email, then remove belongings and trash when you finish.
cards.short_summary: A reservable room prioritized for interviews and remote work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Career & Professional Development reservation form lists Interview Room 117 and states that interviews and remote work receive priority access.
cards.source_title: Interview Room Reservation Form | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: University email is required. Reservations are available 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; the room is unavailable on holidays and weekends.

cards.title: Interview Room 118
cards.subtitle: Career & Professional Development, 116 Armacost Library
cards.notes: Book this room for remote work or an interview with your University email, and follow the stated rule permitting only water inside.
cards.short_summary: A second reservable Career & Professional Development room for focused remote work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Career & Professional Development reservation form lists Interview Room 118 and states that interviews and remote work receive priority access.
cards.source_title: Interview Room Reservation Form | University of Redlands
cards.access_notes: University email is required. Reservations are available 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; the room is unavailable on holidays and weekends.
